## Product Discovery & Build

Read the repository-local skill (a generated adapter under this repository's `.agents/skills/`, `.claude/skills/` or `.grok/skills/` folder, where present) before implementation; the canonical source is `Bthornton1994/OpenMausBot` `standards/shared-skills/product-discovery-build/`. This workflow is guidance, not permission enforcement.

## Universal Pre-Launch Gate

Before an owner release decision, use the `universal-pre-launch-gate` skill to audit the exact release-candidate SHA against its 20-check, evidence-based gate. Read the repository-local skill (a generated adapter under this repository's `.agents/skills/`, `.claude/skills/` or `.grok/skills/` folder, where present); the canonical source is `Bthornton1994/OpenMausBot` `standards/shared-skills/universal-pre-launch-gate/`. This repository's own release, security, and privacy gates apply and win where stricter. The gate reports READY FOR OWNER RELEASE DECISION, NOT READY, or BLOCKED; it never grants permission to merge, deploy, spend, or launch. If the skill is unavailable, report the missing adapter. This workflow is guidance, not permission enforcement.
